name: ColourSeparation
description: Colour separation: a red workpiece is pushed out, a blue one is let go, eight workpieces in all.

local.name: State
local.comment: One state per step: 0 wait for a workpiece, 1 push it out, 2 pull the plate back, 3 let a blue one go by

local.name: Settle
local.comment: A workpiece must lie still against the blade before its colour is read

local.name: Clear
local.comment: A released workpiece must leave the blade before the blade holds again

inputs.name: Waiting
inputs.comment: EyeBlade.detect: a workpiece waits against the blade

inputs.name: IsRed
inputs.comment: ColourSensor.isRed: the workpiece at the blade is red

inputs.name: Extended
inputs.comment: Pusher1.extended: the plate is at the end of its stroke

inputs.name: Retracted
inputs.comment: Pusher1.retracted: the plate is back at rest

outputs.name: RunOut
outputs.comment: Outfeed.run: run the belt to the blue bin

outputs.name: RunSide
outputs.comment: SideBelt.run: run the belt to the red bin

outputs.name: Hold
outputs.comment: Blade1.extend: the blade holds the workpiece while true

outputs.name: Push
outputs.comment: Pusher1.extend: push the workpiece onto the side belt

outputs.name: Done
outputs.comment: Beacon.green: all eight workpieces are handled
